header.running_head: What Happened to the Transgressors who Harmed Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA)

blocks.text: What Happened to the Transgressors who Harmed Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA)
What Happened to Two Persons who Disobeyed Rasulullaah ﷺ

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Abbaas bin Sahl bin Sa'd Saa'idi
blocks.text:
Hadhrat Abbaas bin Sahl bin Sa'd Saa'idi reports that when Rasulullaah ﷺ was passing by the area of Hijr (where the Thamud tribe were destroyed), he dismounted and the Sahabah (RA) drew water from the well that was there. When they were done, Rasulullaah ﷺ instructed the Sahabah (RA) saying, "Do not drink from this water, do not make wudhu with it for salaah and if any dough was made with it, it should be fed to the animals. In addition to this, none of you should leave the camp tonight unless accompanied by another."
All of the Sahabah (RA) complied with the instruction except for two of them, both of whom belonged to the Banu Saa'idah tribe. While one left the camp to relieve himself, the other went out in search of his camel. The one who went out to relieve himself was throttled (by a Jinn) and the other who was searching for his camel was swept up by a tempest and thrown between the two mountains of the Banu Tay tribe (in Yemen). When Rasulullaah ﷺ was informed of this, he said, "Did I not forbid you all from leaving the camp unless accompanied by another?" Rasulullaah ﷺ then made du'aa for the one who was throttled and he was cured. The other Sahabi (RA) rejoined Rasulullaah ﷺ at Tabook. Another narration states the Banu Tay tribe sent him back to Rasulullaah ﷺ after Rasulullaah ﷺ had returned to Madinah.[^1]
What Happened to Jahjaa Ghifaari because he Harmed Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA)

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) reports that Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) was delivering a sermon from the pulpit when Hadhrat Jahjaa Ghifaari (RA) stood up, grabbed Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA)'s staff and struck his knee so hard that the staff broke and Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA)'s knee was seriously injured. Within the same year, Allaah afflicted Hadhrat Jahjaa (RA) with a disease that affected his arm and actually ate away the flesh. He passed away with this condition.[^2]

Another narration states that Hadhrat Jahjaa bin Sa'eed Ghifaari (RA) once confronted Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA), snatched his stick from his hand and struck him so hard on his knee that the stick broke. The people were outraged, but Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) merely got off the pulpit and went home. Allaah then afflicted Hadhrat Jahjaa Ghifaari (RA)'s knee with a disease that killed him before the year had ended.[^3]
Ibn Is'haaq, as quoted in Al Bidaayah wan Nihaayah (Vol.5 Pg.11). Abu Nu'aym has reported a similar narration in his Dalaa'il (Pg.190).
Ibnus Sakan and Baawardi, as quoted in Isaabah (Vol.1 Pg.253).
